quotations.old_english: locan deófla he released the sons of men from the prison of devils
quotations.english: he released the sons of men from the prison of devils

quotations.old_english: Da ðe ic na reáfode ðá ic alýsde
Ðá wæs of ðæm hróran helm and byrne alýsed
quotations.english: then was helm and byrnie loosed from the active chief

source_text: locan deófla he released the sons of men from the prison of devils, Elen. Kmbl. 361; El. 181. Da ðe ic na reáfode ðá ic alýsde quæ non rapui tunc exsolvebam, Ps. Spl. C. 68, 6: 48, 7. Ðú beó fram him alýsed liberatus sis ab illo. Lk. Bos. 12, 58. Ðá wæs of ðæm hróran helm and byrne alýsed then was helm and byrnie loosed from the active chief, Beo. Th. 3264; B. 1630. We synt alýsde liberati sumus, Ps. Th. 123, 7: 107, 5. Ðæt hí wǽron alýsede ut liberentur, 59, 4.
